title: Embedding quantization probe: hybrid INT8/FP16 calibration and cosine stability watchdog
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Build a robust probe for embedding quantization that supports hybrid INT8/FP16 profiles, automated calibration, and continuous cosine-similarity stability checks across corpora. This ticket wires up a calibration harness, a holdout-based accuracy validator, and an operational 'cosine watchdog' that gates canary rollouts and triggers alerts when drift is detected.

Motivation: Prior audits showed sensitivity to per-layer scale factors and activation distributions that cause sub-1% cosine shifts to become user-visible regressions in RAG and similarity search. We need an automated, repeatable pipeline that: 1) generates quant profiles per model/variant, 2) validates embedding fidelity on multiple corpora including synthetic perturbations, and 3) enforces rollout gates via the Console and alerting.

Scope: Hybrid INT8/FP16 quant profiles (per-channel weight quant, activation-aware scaling), calibration dataset management, holdout and adversarial test generation, nightly and pre-rollout checks, Canary gating integration with rollout service, dashboards and alerting rules. Not in scope: training-aware quantization research and per-customer on-prem calibration (follow-on ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness produces reproducible quant profile artifacts (metadata + per-layer scales) for model variants: returns a stable JSON signature for a given seed and dataset.

Validation job computes pairwise cosine distributions between FP16 baseline and quantized INT8 outputs for three corpora (wiki-anchors, product-descriptions, customer-support-samples) and writes summarized metrics to the metrics pipeline.

Cosine-watchdog generates a daily drift score per-corpus and raises an alert when mean cosine drops more than 0.007 or 99th percentile angular deviation increases beyond 0.02 radians compared to baseline.
Nightly run produces an artifacts bundle (calibration profile, sample vectors, histogram, KS-test result) stored in S3 and linked from the ticket for auditability.
Canary rollout integration: if drift > threshold, rollout is automatically paused and an annotated PR request is opened for the platform lead, with automated rollback instructions documented.
Runbook added to Confluence with playbook steps and remediation checklist.
implementation_plan: Design calibration harness that supports per-channel symmetric INT8 quantization and fallback to FP16 for sensitive layers.
Implement activation-aware min/max collector and bias-correction pass during calibration; persist profile in 'quant-profile-v1' schema.
Create calibration datasets: canonical_holdout (10k), adversarial_perturbations (500 synthetic variants), and customer_sample_set (anonymized subset).
Build validation job that: computes baseline FP16 embeddings, quantized embeddings, cosine distribution, angular distance metrics, KS-test, and per-sample delta logging.
Wire validation outputs to metrics: embedding.cosine.mean_diff, embedding.cosine.p99_delta, embedding.ks_pvalue, embedding.histogram_buckets.
Implement Cosine Watchdog service: ingest daily metrics, compare against stored baseline signatures, compute anomaly score, emit alert if threshold exceeded.
Add Canary gating: integrate watchdog with rollout service to pause/rollback canaries and annotate console with failure reason and artifact links.
Create dashboard: per-model-version panels for baseline vs current cosine histogram, p99 angular deviation, and small-sample scatter plots.
Add automated PR template and rollback script that can be triggered by the watchdog and includes S3 artifact links, GitHub PR link, and checklist.
tests_and_validation: Unit tests for calibration code covering symmetric/asymmetric scaling and bias correction (target >90% line coverage for calibration module).
End-to-end nightly pipeline runs against a static snapshot dataset to verify reproducibility across nodes (compare profile hashes).
Create synthetic perturbation suite to simulate diurnal distribution shifts (token dropout, punctuation noise, paraphrase models) and verify that anomaly scoring is robust to benign shifts.
Golden baseline test: assert mean cosine vs FP16 baseline within 0.007 for canonical_holdout; fail the run otherwise.
Canary pre-rollout smoke: run small-sample 1k vectors and assert p99 angular deviation < 0.02 radians before allowing traffic ramp.
observability: Metrics emitted to Prometheus: embedding_cosine_mean_diff{model,variant,corpus}, embedding_cosine_p99_delta{...}, embedding_ks_pvalue{...}, embedding_anomaly_score{...}.
Traces: calibration.job.{start,end}, validation.run.{id}, watchdog.evaluation.{id} with link to S3 bundle.
Dashboards: Console -> Models -> Quantization Stability (per-version), and a Canary gating panel with last evaluation result and artifact links.
Alerts: PagerDuty critical for anomaly_score > 0.9 and mean_diff > 0.015; PagerDuty page for severity P0 followed by Slack #embed-ops notification for medium severity.
Retention: keep nightly artifacts for 90 days; keep summary metrics for 1 year for longitudinal trend analysis.
rollout_plan: Week 1: internal dev rollouts, run harness on dev cluster, iterate on profile schema and scale factors.
Week 2: run nightly pipeline on staging models and prepare baseline signatures for production candidates.
Week 3: enable canary gating for a small percentage of traffic (1-2%) with automated pause on watchdog fail.
Week 4: increase canary to 10% if stable, collect 7 days of telemetry, then full rollout with continued nightly checks.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Calibration non-determinism across hardware leads to flaky baselines. Mitigation: fix random seeds, snapshot micro-batches, and include a reproducibility hash in the artifact.

Risk: Small corpora show high variance and generate false positives. Mitigation: require multi-corpus agreement (>=2 corpora crossing thresholds) before auto-pause, and run KS-test to separate distributional shifts from mean shifts.
Risk: Alert noise overloads on-call. Mitigation: tiered alerts (info/warning/critical), cooldown windows, and aggregate alert grouping by model family.
Risk: Canary pause causes traffic degradation. Mitigation: automatic fallback to FP16 variant and rate-limited rollback with operator notification.
